summary_1line: Bhishma lists primordial Prajapatis, classes of gods, and sages by direction, then begins a tale explaining Vishnu’s intervention against oppressive Danavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: The distressed Earth, burdened by countless fierce Danavas, appears to sink downward while frightened gods flee across the heavens.
The Adityas stand before the Self-born Brahman in the celestial realm, pleading for relief from the oppression of the Danavas.
Bhishma arrives at Markandeya’s hermitage where thousands of ascetics sit together and offer him honey and curds in welcome.
